meta.notes: Decimals are strings; enums are their values; datetimes carry +05:30. Config is OptionsConfig() defaults, written into the inputs. Regenerate with `uv run python ../tools/parity/golden_options.py` from decile-blueprint; packages/core/tests/test_options_goldens.py recomputes every case from these inputs.

caveats: Prices are modelled, not observed. Real expiry-day premiums, skew and slippage differ from a flat-VIX Black–Scholes; treat the P&L as a shape, not a number.
